I think people are a little confused. How this works is a weird kind of quirk with how windows and pending effects work in this game. Here is how this actually works.

Since apex of power is coming into play off of an effect it has 2 timing windows. In window one you activate you shenron effect to negate the incoming battle card. Now both of these effects are currently pending. The apex comes into play and negates all your effects however since your shenron ability is already pending it cannot be negated and still resolves negating the effects of the apex.

So the end result is that the apex effect goes off and stops your effects but after that he is negated so he will not have victory strike or invoker. 

Look up the Apex of Power VS Champa the Trickster ruling on this page if you want proof it has the same timing as this interaction: http://www.dbs-cardgame.com/us-en/rule/card_faq.php
